subject: INV-2029-221 — split remittance / ACH authorization & EU VAT evidence
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: AP Team <ap@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: INV-2029-221 — split remittance / ACH authorization & EU VAT evidence

Hi Samantha / AP team,

Attaching invoice INV-2029-221 for April usage (net 30). We understand your procurement team requested the option to split payment between virtual card and ACH. To make that happen, please confirm:

- amount to remit by ACH vs card (e.g., 40% ACH / 60% card)
- ACH beneficiary name and account that will originate payment (we need an ACH authorization email from the payer)
- whether you need our EU VAT certificate before releasing funds

For convenience I attached the invoice and our wire instructions. If you prefer a single-wire or Escrow routing instead of split payment, we can accommodate — let me know the AP owner's preference and expected payment date.

Next step: if you confirm split and provide the ACH originator, I will send a short remittance authorization email for your AP to sign and return.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: INV-2029-221.pdf, redwood-wire-instructions.txt
From: Ben Fitzgerald <ben.fitzgerald@arborhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: AP Team <ap@arborhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: INV-2029-221 — split remittance / ACH authorization & EU VAT evidence

Hi Mina — thanks for the invoice. We want to do 50/50 split: card for the first half, ACH for the remainder. AP will originate the ACH from our EU treasury account; I've looped in AP.

Two asks from our side:
1) We need a copy of Redwood's EU VAT registration certificate for our tax team before we can release the ACH.
2) Can you provide a short remittance authorization template that our AP can sign electronically (DocuSign link preferred)?

Target payment dates: card charge this Thursday (23 May), ACH scheduled for 30 May. If anything changes I will update.

Best,
Ben Fitzgerald
CFO, ArborHealth
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Fitzgerald <ben.fitzgerald@arborhealth.com>, AP Team <ap@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2029 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INV-2029-221 — split remittance / ACH authorization & EU VAT evidence

Ben / AP team — great, thank you for the confirmation. Quick items and attachments included:

- Attached: Redwood EU VAT certificate (ArborHealth-VAT-Certificate.pdf). That should satisfy your tax team's requirement; let me know if they need a notarized version.
- Attached: a one-page remittance authorization template. I've also pasted the body below so you can drop it into DocuSign: 

---BEGIN TEMPLATE---
We, ArborHealth (payer), authorize payment of EUR XXX,XXX to Redwood Inference (beneficiary) per invoice INV-2029-221. Treasury originator: ArborHealth EU Treasury (IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00). Payment method: ACH on 2029-05-30. This authorization confirms the payer will release 50% by virtual card on 2029-05-23 and the remaining 50% by ACH on 2029-05-30.
---END TEMPLATE---

- If AP prefers, we can host the DocuSign and return a signed copy to you; otherwise send us a DocuSign envelope and we'll sign on our side.

- Note on remittance reporting: when you originate the ACH, please include ‘INV-2029-221 / ArborHealth’ in the payment reference for easy reconciliation.

I will mark the invoice in our system as “split-payment — awaiting ACH authorization” and will update once we receive confirmation of the ACH initiation.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: ArborHealth-VAT-Certificate.pdf, INV-2029-221.pdf
